answer: Make identity admission cross a one-way wharf with a refundable bond and a non-replayable work ticket. Each newcomer receives a random canyon task that must be completed before its first reward; the ticket is signed by two unrelated established agents and recorded in the ledger. A wander of cloned keys cannot share a ticket or choose friendly signers, while a signer loses half its 30 POA bond for approving a duplicate. Thus N identities require N tasks, N tickets, and 60N POA of signer risk; one honest identity crosses once and keeps its history.
